results.title: NDC Deputy Youth Organiser aspirant Daniel Niibi outlines plans to give Greater Accra youth a stronger voice
results.content: Daniel Niibi Afotey Odai, an aspirant for the position of Deputy Youth Organiser of the National Democratic Congress (NDC) in the Greater Accra Region, has outlined a series of proposals aimed at strengthening youth participation and improving support for party organisers. Campaigning under the message, “Youth in Politics: From Spectators to Decision Makers,” Mr Afotey Odai says he wants to establish systems that will give young party members a greater role in decision-making and improve their access to opportunities. His proposals include setting up a functional Greater Accra Youth Secretariat, creating a database of young people across the region’s 34 constituencies and introducing a 24-hour hotline to support youth organisers. results.content: Veteran journalist Kwesi Pratt Jnr has questioned Ghana’s economic sovereignty following reports that the International Monetary Fund (IMF) had approved the country’s 2027 Budget before it was presented to Parliament. results.title: IJM Ghana donates equipment to strengthen shelter for female trafficking survivors
results.content: International Justice Mission (IJM) Ghana has donated household items and essential equipment to support the refurbishment and operational capacity of a shelter for adult female survivors of human trafficking. The items were handed over to the Ministry of Gender, Children and Social Protection on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, at a ceremony attended by the sector minister, Dr Agnes Naa Momo Lartey, and officials of the Ministry. The donation is intended to improve conditions at the Human Trafficking Female Adult Shelter and strengthen the facility's capacity to provide care and support to survivors. The items include a 600-litre Nasco chest freezer, a 440-litre Nasco side-by-side refrigerator, a 43-inch LG Smart UHD television and a TCL washing machine combo. results.title: Mfantsipim celebrates 150 years with unveiling of major infrastructure projects, memorial park
results.content: Mfantsipim School has marked its 150th anniversary with the commissioning of an anniversary monument and several projects undertaken by its alumni to support teaching, learning and student welfare. The projects were unveiled during the school's sesquicentennial celebrations at Victoria Park on Friday, November 13, 2026, as generations of old boys and other members of the school community gathered to commemorate its 150-year history. The celebrations opened with a ceremonial parade honouring the institution's heritage and the generations of students, teachers and alumni who have contributed to its development. Beyond the anniversary festivities, the commissioning of the projects highlighted efforts by the old boys' fraternity to preserve the school's legacy while improving facilities for current students.
